nodes.name: Central Table
nodes.description: A dark round table. Wetberry stands upright in the center beside suspicious moisture.

nodes.name: Fridge of Forgotten Things
nodes.description: The fridge hums with extradimensional resentment.

nodes.name: Coffee Counter
nodes.description: The coffee maker clicks even when unplugged.

nodes.name: Utility Corner
nodes.description: A mop bucket waits with the grim dignity of a veteran.

nodes.name: Door Shelf
nodes.description: The door shelf contains expired condiments and strange labels.

nodes.name: Leftover Marshes
nodes.description: A swamp of forgotten meals and mysterious bacterial growth.

nodes.name: Yogurt Catacombs
nodes.description: Towers of moldy yogurt containers, now empty.

nodes.name: Back Corner
nodes.description: A quiet corner where the Oldest Relic waits. You feel watched.

nodes.name: The Forgotten Hallway
nodes.description: A hallway nobody remembers. The fluorescent lights flicker in a pattern that almost spells words.

nodes.name: Vendrick's Domain
nodes.description: A sentient vending machine hums with an ancient, judgmental intelligence. Its display reads: 'INSERT MEMORY.'

nodes.name: The Accountability Slot
nodes.description: A glowing slot in the wall where genuine accountability is deposited. It smells like honesty and regret.

nodes.name: Snack Wraith Aisle
nodes.description: Phantom snacks float through the air, their wrappers crinkling with the echoes of lunch breaks past.

name: The Fridge Labyrinth of Forgotten Leftovers

nodes.name: Labyrinth Entry
nodes.description: A cold tunnel behind the vending machine's back panel. The air tastes like abandoned meal prep and ancient condiment regret.

nodes.name: Condiment Gate
nodes.description: A gate of crystallized ketchup and ancient mustard blocks the path. A Condiment Guardian stands sentinel.

nodes.name: Leftover Catacombs
nodes.description: Tunnels of forgotten Tupperware stretch in every direction. Each container whispers the name of the person who abandoned it.

nodes.name: Freezer Shrine
nodes.description: An ancient freezer chamber where frozen meals are preserved in eternal frost. Their foil lids are still crimped with hope.

nodes.name: Casserole Throne
nodes.description: The deepest chamber. A sentient casserole sits upon a throne of stacked takeout containers, its noodle arms spread wide in resentful majesty.

nodes.name: Antechamber of Summons
nodes.description: A waiting room paneled in the same fluorescent dread as the breakroom, but formalized: numbered tickets, a silent queue, a bell that has never been rung by anyone who wanted to.

nodes.name: Records Hall
nodes.description: Filing cabinets stretch beyond where the ceiling should be. Somewhere in here is every note ever left on a communal fridge.

nodes.name: Holding Pen
nodes.description: A carpeted room with too many chairs and not enough air. Bailiff Gorrum stands by the inner door, patient as a mountain.

nodes.name: Hearing Arena
nodes.description: The inner door opens onto a ringed chamber, rope and post and mat, lit for testimony rather than combat. It still feels like a fight.

nodes.name: Verdict Vault
nodes.description: A small, quiet room behind the arena where verdicts are sealed and handed down, one at a time, with no audience left to see it.
